description: Held-out package corpus. No package labelled safe:true appears verbatim in src/android_optimiser/analysis/knowledge.py, and the entries marked 'unknown to the KB' match no vendor prefix rule either. They test whether the classifier's vendor-family rules, telemetry patterns and structural signals generalise to handsets and firmware the knowledge base has never seen, rather than relying on per-package memorisation. Three entries deliberately name protected packages: a protection list necessarily has to name what it protects, and those entries test that the classifier does not over-reach.

labels.safe: Disabling this package is correct and low-risk.
labels.unsafe: Disabling this package is wrong: either it breaks the device, or it removes an app the user installed on purpose.
